name: singlet_immune_repertoire_chain_pairing_dual_receptor_calling
title: Chain pairing and dual-receptor calling
description: Assigns each cell's receptor contigs to primary and secondary chains per locus family and labels its pairing class (single, dual, orphan, doublet suspect or ambiguous) with a keep flag. The default is the published scirpy receptor rule; top2_tpm and dandelion_dominance are alternatives. Input is a contig table from receptor_contig_assembly; writes per-cell obs labels. Do not use it to define clonotypes or to call doublets from expression.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle. Needs the contigs table from receptor_contig_assembly.

method.description: scirpy_chain_qc is the default published rule; dandelion_dominance applies fold-change dominance; top2_tpm needs contigs/tpm.

productive_only.description: Drop non-productive contigs before ranking and multichain counting. Keep true unless the assembler already filters.

require_high_confidence.description: Keep only contigs with is_cell and high_confidence when those flags exist, as in 10x-derived tables.

max_chains_per_family.description: Chains kept per locus family as primary and secondary; a cell with more is flagged multichain.

min_umi_secondary.description: Minimum UMI count for a secondary contig to be kept; 1 disables it. The value 2 is proposed and needs benchmark B2.

scirpy.description: Options used only when method is scirpy_chain_qc.

require_junction_aa.description: Drop contigs without a CDR3 amino-acid sequence before ranking and counting.

dandelion.description: Options used only when method is dandelion_dominance.

umi_foldchange_cutoff.description: Fold change over the second contig that makes the top UMI contig dominant.

consensus_foldchange_cutoff.description: Consensus-count fold change used as the second dominance criterion.

allow_exceptions.description: Allow TRB with TRD and IGM with IGD to co-occur without marking ambiguity.

ntop_vdj.description: Number of productive VDJ contigs considered for dominance.

ntop_vj.description: Number of productive VJ contigs considered for dominance.

device.description: Execution device; auto uses CPU except for batch scans of very large contig tables.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing obs and uns members written by a previous call instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/pairing_class. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Counts per pairing class, multichain and no-IR cells, and the rule used. Never per-contig rows.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
